grades: Teen Tech Tutors and Local History: grades 9 to 12. Summer volunteers: grades 7 to 12. Service crafts and T(w)een board: grades 6 to 8.
pay_detail: Unpaid. Volunteer work counts toward service hours.
name: Teen Volunteers: Tech Tutors, Local History and Summer Volunteers
city: Libertyville and Vernon Hills, IL (Lake County)
what_you_do: Give one-on-one tech help as a Teen Tech Tutor, help with local history work like photocopying and data entry, or volunteer in the summer. Younger teens can do service craft programs or join a T(w)een Advisory Board. Volunteer work counts as service hours.
who_can_apply: Students in the grades listed for each role.
deadline_text: Teen Tech Tutor applications for fall 2026 were reviewed until October 15, 2026, so that round is over. The Local History Assistant role (grades 9 to 12) has an Apply link and no deadline. Service craft programs and the T(w)een Advisory Board use event sign ups. The Summer 2026 youth volunteer period has closed, and the Seed Library role is closed for now.
how_to_apply: Click Apply for the role you want on the volunteer page. Questions about youth roles: Kevin, kwonch@cooklib.org. Questions about high school roles: Leah, lhotchkiss@cooklib.org.
notes: You need a library card for the adult volunteer jobs.
